artifact_observations.reasoning: The wood grain texture appears slightly repetitive and 'painted on' in some areas, lacking the fine micro-detail expected in a high-resolution photo, though consistent with AI generation smoothing.
The forklift structure blends slightly into the background and lacks clear mechanical definition; the tines/forks are indistinct or missing, appearing as a vague dark shape.
Minor warping in the straight lines of the lumber edges at the bottom right, suggesting slight geometric instability in the generation.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the scene is correctly classified as a lumbermill/industrial wood storage rather than generic construction or warehouse.
To verify that individual planks have distinct boundaries and do not merge into each other (fusion artifact).
To ensure the forklift is properly grounded in 3D space relative to the wood piles and not floating or bleeding into them.
To assess the realism of the wood textures and lighting consistency.

focus_areas: Boundary separation between individual lumber planks
Structural integrity and recognizability of the forklift
Consistency of wood grain texture across different stacks
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the forklift on the left; AI often fails to render complex machinery details correctly, resulting in melting or missing parts. Also, inspect the gaps between the wood planks—ensure they are consistent and don't show 'bleeding' or impossible geometry where planks merge.
